cta.title: Power Shouldn't Be Bound by the Grid.
cta.text: Join the next generation of energy independence with korol.

hero.title: We Build Power That Doesn't Ask Permission.
hero.subtitle: korol exists because energy access shouldn't be a function of geography, infrastructure budgets or utility timelines. We engineer systems that generate, store and deliver power wherever it's needed.

mission.title: Decentralize the Grid. Permanently.
mission.text1: Centralised energy infrastructure was designed for a different century. It's expensive to extend, slow to permit and fragile under stress. Our mission is to make autonomous clean energy the default choice — not the backup plan — for fleets, industry and emergency services.
mission.text2: We do this by building the entire stack ourselves: solar harvesting, storage chemistry, power electronics and the software that orchestrates all of it.

items.title: Field Reliability
items.text: If it can't survive a dust storm, a monsoon and a -20°C night, it doesn't ship. Every enclosure is tested beyond its rated envelope.

items.title: Radical Simplicity
items.text: Complex energy systems fail at the seams. We reduce part counts, remove single points of failure and design for one-person deployment.

items.title: Full Lifecycle
items.text: We account for the cell, the enclosure and the end-of-life recovery. Recyclability is a design constraint, not a marketing line.

items.title: Open Telemetry
items.text: Customers own their operational data. Trevoli exports to any standard format — no lock-in, no proprietary black boxes.

items.text: Three engineers, one prototype LFP pack and a problem statement: why does off-grid EV charging cost more than the vehicle?

deepDive.title: Every Component Is Ours.
deepDive.text: We didn't assemble off-the-shelf parts. The BMS, the MPPT controller, the thermal management layer and the firmware running on top are all designed and validated in-house — which is why we can guarantee the numbers on the datasheet.
items: Custom battery management system with per-cell monitoring
High-efficiency MPPT tracking with dual-input channel support
Passive and active thermal regulation for -20°C to 55°C operation

items.q: Do korol units need any grid connection at all?
items.a: No. Every platform generates and stores its own power from solar input. A grid connection is optional and only used if you want to top up during extended low-irradiance periods — the system operates fully without one.
Nomad and Responder units deploy in under ten minutes with one person. Depot installations typically complete within a single working day and require no trenching, permitting or civil works.

items.q: What happens during extended cloudy weather?
items.a: Every system is sized with a reserve margin based on your regional irradiance profile. Trevoli also provides predictive load balancing that prioritises critical loads as stored energy declines.

items.q: Can I monitor multiple sites at once?
items.a: Yes. Trevoli aggregates telemetry across your entire fleet into a single dashboard, with per-asset drill-down, alerting and exportable reporting.
Storage systems carry a 10-year performance warranty. Power electronics carry 5 years. Full terms are provided with every quotation.

hero.title: Trevoli Manages Every Watt.
hero.subtitle: The intelligence layer across the korol ecosystem. Predictive load balancing, remote diagnostics, fleet telemetry and biometric access control — in one operating system.

items.title: Predictive Load Balancing
items.text: Trevoli forecasts demand against irradiance and stored reserve, then shifts non-critical loads automatically as energy margins tighten.

items.title: Real-Time Telemetry
items.text: Per-cell voltage, temperature, cycle count and throughput streamed continuously from every asset in the fleet.

items.title: Biometric Access Control
items.text: Restrict charging and enclosure access to authorised operators using fingerprint or credential verification at the unit.

items.title: Over-the-Air Updates
items.text: Firmware improvements and new optimisation models deploy to the entire fleet remotely — no site visits required.

items.title: Anomaly Detection
items.text: Deviation from expected charge and discharge curves triggers an alert before it becomes a failure or a safety event.

items.title: Reporting & Export
items.text: Carbon avoided, energy served and uptime metrics exportable to CSV, JSON or your existing BI tooling.

architecture.title: How Trevoli Works.
architecture.text: A lightweight edge controller runs on every korol unit, collecting high-frequency data and executing local decisions even when offline. When connectivity is available, it syncs to the cloud for fleet-wide optimisation and reporting.

steps.title: Sense
steps.text: The edge controller samples cell voltage, current, temperature and irradiance at high frequency across every module.

steps.title: Decide
steps.text: Local models balance charge distribution, thermal load and output priority without waiting for a round trip to the cloud.

steps.title: Sync
steps.text: Aggregated telemetry syncs securely to your Trevoli workspace, where fleet-wide trends and alerts are generated.

steps.title: Optimize
steps.text: New optimisation parameters push back down to each unit over the air, improving performance without any site visit.

security.title: Your Data Stays Yours.
security.text: Telemetry is encrypted in transit and at rest. Customers retain full ownership of operational data, and every export format is open and documented — no proprietary lock-in, ever.
items: Role-based access with per-site permission scoping
Full audit trail for every access and configuration change
Biometric verification at the physical unit
No third-party data resale, at any tier
